highlights: Every Leafday, 9 AM to 1 PM: set up a stall in Fernwick and sell your fish, dishes and garden things at your own prices.
Folk haggle when you're a little dear, pay more for their favourites, and order fish for next week at double the price.
An awning, a brass bell, a weighing scale, a chalkboard special and a second table, plus a reputation that grows with every sale.
Sell 60 things at your stall to become a Stallholder.
notes: Your market stall: from your second day, Mayor Hazel keeps you a pitch at the top of the lake path in Fernwick. Every Leafday from 9 AM to 1 PM, fill up to four crates with fish, dishes and garden things, chalk up your prices and open up. The morning goes by while neighbours and visitors stop at the stall. Nothing leaves your basket until it sells, so packing up early never loses anything.

Everyone has their own idea of a fair price: under it they buy (two, if it's a bargain), a little over and they haggle (Deal or No thanks), too far over and they walk on. Neighbours pay more for their favourite fish and dish, warm to you when you sell cheap, and now and then order a fish for next Leafday at double the price.

Reputation grows with every sale and brings more people by, up to folk from Saltmarsh. Five stall upgrades in the Your stall tab: a Striped Awning, a Brass Bell you can ring, a Weighing Scale, a Chalkboard special and a Second Table for six crates.
Market day is on the calendar and in the HUD notes (click the note to walk to the stall), and there's a new Stallholder badge for selling 60 things.
